job.purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed nhb_pbst_ref-q5b-ebf1805fa (ot_nhb_pbst, RTL ebf1805fa, snapshot of 2 drifted files): same RTL, outline 151.2x151.2, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Claude:el1011-q-kvd

benches.name: lint
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/ot_nhb_pbst_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/ot_nhb_pbst_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_nhb_pbst u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qwen_nearhbm_attn_hub_t.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_nhb_tiles.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qwen_nearhbm_attn_hub_p.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qwen_nearhbm_sfu_p.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_sfu.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat_nr.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the ebf1805fa snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/ot_nhb_pbst_m5/src]
